name: dYdX V3
rootCause: On July 23, the dydx.exchange domain was discovered to have been compromised. The attacker changed the DNS Nameservers from Cloudflare to DDoS-Guard. The attacker also successfully removed the DNSSEC settings on the domain. The attacker hosted a malicious site which requested that any connected wallets transfer ETH and other ERC20 tokens to the attacker’s Ethereum address. Two users were affected, resulting in a loss of approximately $31,000.

descriptions.text: On July 23, the dydx.exchange domain was discovered to have been compromised. The attacker changed the DNS Nameservers from Cloudflare to DDoS-Guard. On July 23, 2024, dYdX V3's frontend was hijacked via a DNS attack, redirecting users to a phishing site. Two users lost a total of approximately $31,000 after interacting with the fake interface. The backend smart contracts were unaffected, and dYdX quickly restored domain control. The incident was caused by a DNS nameserver hijacking following a registrar migration, allowing attackers to disable DNSSEC and redirect dydx.exchange to a phishing frontend. This exposed visiting users to malicious wallet connection prompts and token approval requests.
